problems.memo_sentence: "The authors further emphasize that the training protocol is not restricted to any specific distribution family, aiming at broadly applicable model calibration and distribution loading for financial data."

The source only explicitly supports the narrower non-specific-distribution claim.

problems.memo_sentence: "The authors propose a statistics-informed parameterized quantum circuit (SI-PQC) designed via the maximum entropy principle, with a static structure and trainable parameters that encode statistical information as rotation angles in a dedicated parameterized layer."
problems.source_evidence: "For preparing tasks, the costly pre-computing or pre-training procedure is no longer needed [16, 17, 29, 30], and hence any in-depth circuit compilation optimizing is permitted."
problems.explanation: The memo captures the static/trainable structure but omits the paper's explicit condition that this advantage applies to preparing tasks and is tied to avoiding costly pre-computing or pre-training. That contextual qualifier is part of the source's claim.

problems.memo_sentence: "The paper reports that MEDL can prepare any statistical distribution as a maximum-entropy quantum state with circuit depth scaling as O(M d_f log(1/(F ε))) and O(log n) ancillary qubits, with success probability O(1/F), and that the depth scales linearly with the number of qubits n."
problems.source_evidence: "The circuit depth is O{Mdf log(1/Fϵ)} with O(log n) ancillary qubits and success probability O(1/F), given the data space qubit number n, constraints number M, maximum constraint order df, filling rate F = ∥p∥2/∥p∥max, and precision ϵ. Herein, the circuit depth scales linearly as the qubit number n and hence can serve as an efficient amplitude-encoded state preparation subroutine..."
problems.explanation: The memo states the scaling but omits the paper's explicit dependence on the filling rate F and maximum constraint order df as conditions for the complexity result. Those are central qualifiers in the theorem statement, not optional details.

problems.memo_sentence: "The authors state that SI-PQC can in principle be extended beyond static distributions to prepare time series, enabling applications to temporal financial modeling."
problems.source_evidence: "In principle, SI-PQC can be extended to prepare time series, to study non-parametric and semi-parametric statistics tests, and to extract information from unknown quantum states. We leave these interesting problems as future works."
problems.explanation: The memo mentions the time-series extension but drops the explicit caveat that this is only an in-principle future-work statement. The source frames it as a prospective direction rather than an established capability.
